classification.difficultyReason: Associate each named vertex with its two incident line equations and repeatedly apply the taught scaled elimination method, keeping exact coordinates.

content.prompt:
The equations of the lines that define $\triangle ABC$ are:
$$\begin{aligned}AB:\quad 5x+y&=10\\BC:\quad 3x-2y&=6\\CA:\quad 4x+5y&=-20\end{aligned}$$
Find the coordinates of $A$, $B$ and $C$.

spec.description: Three equation-driven lines extending beyond their pairwise intersections, with positive axis arrows, the supplied intercept labels and red vertex markers. Ordinary axes and labels are black; graph lines use house blue and marked intersections use house red. No grid or shading.
spec.mathematics: AB: y=10-5x; BC: y=3x/2-3; CA: y=-4x/5-4. A=AB∩CA, B=AB∩BC, C=BC∩CA.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source-supplied lines, intercepts and vertex names are visible; vertex coordinates are not printed.

answer.short:
$A\left(\frac{10}{3},-\frac{20}{3}\right)$, $B(2,0)$, $C\left(-\frac{10}{23},-\frac{84}{23}\right)$.

Solve the equations of the two lines meeting at each vertex.
answer.worked:
At $A$, solve $AB$ and $CA$. Multiply the equation of $AB$ by $5$, then subtract the equation of $CA$:
$$\begin{align*}25x+5y&=50\\(25x+5y)-(4x+5y)&=50-(-20)\\21x&=70\\x&=\frac{10}{3}\\y&=10-5\left(\frac{10}{3}\right)\\y&=-\frac{20}{3}\end{align*}$$
Thus $A\left(\frac{10}{3},-\frac{20}{3}\right)$.

At $B$, solve $AB$ and $BC$. Multiply the equation of $AB$ by $2$, then add the equation of $BC$:
$$\begin{align*}10x+2y&=20\\(10x+2y)+(3x-2y)&=20+6\\13x&=26\\x&=2\\y&=10-5(2)\\y&=0\end{align*}$$
Thus $B(2,0)$.

At $C$, multiply the equation of $BC$ by $5$ and the equation of $CA$ by $2$, then add:
$$\begin{align*}15x-10y&=30\\8x+10y&=-40\\23x&=-10\\x&=-\frac{10}{23}\\y&=\frac{3(-10/23)-6}{2}\\y&=-\frac{84}{23}\end{align*}$$
Thus $C\left(-\frac{10}{23},-\frac{84}{23}\right)$.

Checking the defining equations: at $A$, $5x+y=10$ and $4x+5y=-20$; at $B$, $5x+y=10$ and $3x-2y=6$; at $C$, $3x-2y=\frac{(-30+168)}{23}=6$ and $4x+5y=\frac{(-40-420)}{23}=-20$.
